item.name: Replacement_Kitchen_Propane_Cylinder
item.description: Filled DOT propane cylinder matching the kitchen appliance and regulator. The camp must replace this provisional description with its actual cylinder size and connection.
item.readyBeforeUse: The cylinder is upright, secured, filled, within its requalification date, and free of excessive rust, damage, or a missing valve collar or foot ring.
item.readyForNextPerson: The cylinder is either connected and leak-free or upright, secured, capped, and stored in the propane area.
item.ifNotReady: Do not connect or refill the cylinder. Tell the Propane Lead.
